title: Made a free browser game prototype 100% with AI - looking for honest feedback
author: Busy-Actuary-7391
selftext:
Hey! I made a free browser prototype called Maple Legion: Caravan Siege.



Playable Link:

[https://verse8.io/A5n6c2T](https://verse8.io/A5n6c2T)



It's an idle RPG/card battle prototype with a fantasy caravan siege vibe, made 100% with AI for a Maple x Verse8 event.



I'm trying to figure out what still feels fun/clear vs what feels too AI-ish. Would love feedback from ppl doing AI/game dev stuff.



Quick questions:

\- does the gameplay loop make sense in the first 30-60 sec?

\- do the cards feel like actual mechanics?

\- does the AI-made art/UI feel coherent or too messy?
